title: ADOC: Automatically Harmonizing Dataflow Between Components in Log-Structured Key-Value Stores for Improved Performance
note: Excellent fit. Pure user-space RocksDB auto-tuning framework that controls write stalls by adjusting thread count and batch size to limit data overflow. Evaluation is single-node RocksDB on NVMe SSDs - exactly the target machine. 16 cores and local NVMe are enough to reproduce the write-stall regimes. Concern: the paper sweeps several device classes (SATA SSD, NVMe SSD, Optane) and we only have NVMe, so device-sensitivity results would have to be narrowed or emulated with cgroup v2 I/O throttling.
